data.name: Origins of Lume
data.detailed_description:
Survive a collapsing battlefield in a tactical card game where every move shapes a living fantasy universe.

In Origins of Lume, duels unfold on shifting boards that shrink and collapse, forcing you to adapt your strategy or be swept away. Protect your Summoner, command elemental Guardians, and outwit both your opponent and the unstable arena beneath your feet. 

Journey across 14 elemental realms - from the molten Fire lands to the haunted depths of Death, each adding unique twists to the battlefield. No two matches are ever alike, and survival belongs to those who can read the chaos and turn it into opportunity.

But Origins of Lume is more than a card game, it’s a world you help build. With the in-game Create App (future release), players can design cards (Name, Art, Card mechanics, World), then share them with the community. The universe evolves through your imagination, blending strategy with storytelling.

And beyond the battlefield? Whispers of Tribes, Guild Wars, and shifting politics hint at a larger struggle, where the community itself will decide the fate of the 14 realms.

Design:

Origins of Lume is built for players who love strategic depth as much as story-driven immersion. The design philosophy blends fast tactical decisions with long-term planning, encouraging creativity and risk-taking. Each card has weight, each move can change the outcome, and each game feels like a unique story told on the battlefield.

Key Features

  • 🜂 Dynamic Arenas – Shrinking, shifting boards that demand constant adaptation.

  • 🜁 Strategic Guardians – Elemental champions with buffs and debuffs to shield your Summoner.

  • 🜃 14 Realms of Power – Harness the forces of Elms( Fire, Water, Air…), Xenes (Magic, Atomic..) and Outcasts each bring unique twists.

  • 🜄 Create & Share – Design Cards with the Create App, Create or join a Tribe and shape the game’s future.

  • ⚔️ Superskills & Relics – Unlock rare powers to trade or wield in battle.

✦ Living Universe – Tribes, Guild Wars, and community choices will guide the story yet to come.

data.short_description: Origins of Lume is a tactical trading card game set in a collapsing battlefield where strategy and survival collide. Protect your Summoner, command elemental guardians, and adapt to shifting arenas in a constantly evolving duel of wit and power.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (e.g., Intel Core i3-4130 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU supporting WebGL 2.0 (Intel HD 4600 / UHD 630 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Requires WebGL 2.0–capable drivers; internet required for online play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or recent integrated GPU with WebGL 2.0 support (GTX 1050 / RX 560 / UHD 730+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Stable 60 FPS at 1080p in most scenes.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or Intel Iris Plus 650 (WebGL 2.0 / Metal capable)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Universal build (Apple Silicon & Intel). If Intel-only, note “Intel Only”.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU / AMD Radeon Pro 560X or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Best experience on Apple Silicon.
